beats.text: The villain is temporal blindness. Models treat the world like a static photo, ignoring the evolving 3D state.
beats.visual_focus: A camera shutter closing repeatedly over a shifting environment.

beats.text: AgentVQA shatters this by forcing models to track state changes across 1,000 real-world agent scenarios.

It's refreshing to hear about actual benchmarking instead of just hype.

Why is AgentVQA a major breakthrough? Because vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood.

Everyone thought standard methods were enough, until AgentVQA proved: although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale.
